questions.prompt: How should repeated input values be prepared for duplicate checks?

choices.label: Keep the original order and compare only neighboring input positions.

questions.prompt: When should an unused value equal to its predecessor be skipped?

choices.label: When that equal predecessor has not been used in this branch.
choices.feedback: Requiring equal copies to be chosen in index order avoids duplicate permutations without losing valid repeated-value arrangements.

choices.label: Whenever its equal predecessor has been used.

choices.label: Always, even after all earlier copies are used.
